content:
leo: FYI noticing a cluster of invoice_preview diffs this morning tied to embed-heavy requests. Pattern: route tags missing -> default routing -> higher per-token SKU applied.
anika: Missing tags where in the flow? edge headers, enrich, or during ingest fanout?
derek: Looks like header truncation at edge LB: the X-Route-Meta header was getting cut at 4KB. We started sending richer route metadata last month and some proxies didn't negotiate larger header frames.
viv: That would cause route_enricher to fall back to fallback_route and those requests pick up the premium sku in pricing table. How big is the impact?
leo: Sampling: ~0.6% of requests in 01:00-02:00 UTC, per-tenant invoice_previews show +2-12% token charge on affected tenants. Small % but concentrated on 6 large customers.
metrics-bot: alert: invoice_preview_delta > 1.5% for route=default in prod-eu (last 1h)
anika: Immediate mitigation options? Patch LB config to allow larger headers or change enrichment to parse partial metadata?
derek: Short-term: 2 options
 1) increase proxy header_max_size and restart edge LBs (risky, needs coord)
 2) detect truncated header at enrich and attempt to rehydrate from request body (if present) or mark as 'maybe-truncated' and route to best-effort tag resolver.
viv: I prefer option 2 for immediate low-risk. We can add a tolerant parser and a metric for truncated_header_count. Then roll header_max_size change in maintenance window.
leo: Agree. Also need to avoid charging customers until we reconcile affected previews.
anika: Derek, can you put a tolerant parser in the enricher and canary it?
derek: will open PR for a tolerant parser + metric: ingest.truncated_header_count, ingest.route_recovery_success. Canary on 5% of enrichment workers.
leo: Also add a billing flag: invoice_preview.freeze_for_window(01:00-02:00 UTC, reason="header-truncation")
viv: I'll coordinate with billing automation to freeze finalization for that window. We should also generate a delta report for affected previews.
metrics-bot: deployed: anomaly_detector job scheduled to run reconciliation diff at 7065432600
derek: quick pseudocode of tolerant parse:
```
// try full header
meta = parse_json(header.X_Route_Meta)
if meta missing fields and header.length >= header_max_size-16:
  // attempt to recover from body or from secondary header
  meta = try_recover_from(X_Route_Meta_Alt) or best_effort_lookup(tenant_id, path)
  emit metric ingest.rehydration_attempts++
```
anika: Add unit tests for partial JSON fragments and for the best_effort_lookup fallback returning sane defaults.
leo: For reconciliation: plan is to recompute enrichment using tolerant parser for 01:00-02:00 and produce per-tenant charge_delta.csv in s3://billing-audit/truncation-7065432100/deltas.csv
viv: Billing team will ingest that CSV and mark previews needing manual approval. Also send an email to affected tenants via billing-notify.
anika: Long-term, we should:
- stop sending massive route meta in headers; move to POST body or a signed metadata blob stored in blobstore and referenced by id in header
- add a rollout policy: any change that increases header size must be approved by eng-platform + edge infra + billing product
- dashboard card: route_meta_truncation_rate and preview_charge_delta_by_route
derek: I'll include a migration ticket to switch to metadata-by-ref (MD-412).
metrics-bot: canary deploy started for enricher tolerant-parse (change=CHG-10234) at 7065432360
derek: canary telemetry: ingest.truncated_header_count down 0 -> 0 on canary nodes (we're catching and recovering). route_recovery_success=95% on canary.
leo: Great. Once canary stable for 15m roll to 50% then full.
viv: ETA for reconciliation CSV?
derek: job kicked at 7065432600, estimate 18m. output s3://billing-audit/truncation-7065432100/deltas.csv
viv: Billing freeze in place. Notify ops-runbook channel if any manual credits are issued.
metrics-bot: note: created alert rule ingest.truncated_header_count > 10 (5m) -> pager duty
anika: Also update the rollout checklist: header-size-change checklist entry and gating. I'll file RB-330.
leo: Good work. Keep thread updated. If tenants ask, direct them to billing-review with the S3 CSV link.
deploy-bot: CHG-10234 canary complete at 7065432799. will begin progressive rollout.
